§ 01 · The Program

Real patients,
real decisions.

From handling a medical error and managing a clinical trial, to preventing hospital-acquired infections, coordinating care teams, and leading digital transformation in healthcare, every scenario drops you into a genuine clinical or operational situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Fifty foundations-focused scenarios and fifty strategy-and-regulation-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real clinical judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a healthcare or pharmaceutical professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across patient safety, clinical research, hospital operations, compliance, and digital health.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound clinical judgment under real pressure.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Healthcare Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping healthcare and pharmaceutical professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in healthcare isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, healthcare and pharmaceutical roles in English — Mr. Gad Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the clinical moments you'll actually face.
